Q1: Maneb exhibits known significant hazards (Tier 1) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive effects (CMR), environmental impact (ENV), and organ/systemic toxicity (OGN) according to internationally recognized systems. Q3: Maneb is extensively characterized in scientific literature, evidenced by 3656 references, significantly above the median for characterized chemicals.
